nodes.title: Larkspur
nodes.markdown:
# Larkspur

Larkspur is a **sample project**: a small recipe-sharing app, made up to show what a Hypatia wiki looks like. The people, issues and pull requests here are invented too.

Start at a hub:

- [Web app](docs/wiki/web-app.md) - the pages people see in the browser.
- [API](docs/wiki/api.md) - the server the web app talks to.
- [Data](docs/wiki/data.md) - where recipes and accounts are stored.
- [Operations](docs/wiki/operations.md) - how the app is deployed and watched.

Run `hypatia serve` inside your own repo to see its real pages, people and work instead.
nodes.summary: Larkspur is a sample project: a small recipe-sharing app, made up to show what a Hypatia wiki looks like.

nodes.title: API
nodes.markdown:
# API

The API is one small server. It answers the [web app](web-app.md), checks who is asking with [auth](auth-api.md) and keeps data in the [database](database.md).
nodes.summary: The API is one small server.

nodes.title: Auth
nodes.markdown:
# Auth

Part of: [API](api.md)

Auth sends sign-in links and checks sessions. Sessions live in the [database](database.md).
nodes.summary: Auth sends sign-in links and checks sessions.

last_change.author: Dana Okafor
last_change.message: (sample) Auth: log why a link was refused

nodes.title: Background jobs
nodes.markdown:
# Background jobs

Part of: [API](api.md)

Background jobs do slow work after a request is answered: resizing photos and updating the [search index](search-index.md).
nodes.summary: Background jobs do slow work after a request is answered: resizing photos and updating the search index.

nodes.title: Data
nodes.markdown:
# Data

Data is where everything is kept: the [database](database.md), the [search index](search-index.md) and [file storage](file-storage.md).
nodes.summary: Data is where everything is kept: the database, the search index and file storage.

nodes.title: Database
nodes.markdown:
# Database

Part of: [Data](data.md)

The database holds accounts, recipes and follows. Changes to its tables are written as migrations.
nodes.summary: The database holds accounts, recipes and follows.

last_change.author: Eli Brandt
last_change.message: (sample) Database: drop the unused tags table

nodes.title: Deploys
nodes.markdown:
# Deploys

Part of: [Operations](operations.md)

Every merge to main deploys the [API](api.md) and the [web app](web-app.md) after the tests pass.
nodes.summary: Every merge to main deploys the API and the web app after the tests pass.

nodes.title: Feed
nodes.markdown:
# Feed

Part of: [Web app](web-app.md)

The feed lists new recipes from people a cook follows, newest first, from the [recipes API](recipes-api.md).
nodes.summary: The feed lists new recipes from people a cook follows, newest first, from the recipes API.

nodes.title: File storage
nodes.markdown:
# File storage

Part of: [Data](data.md)

File storage keeps recipe photos, resized by [background jobs](background-jobs.md).
nodes.summary: File storage keeps recipe photos, resized by background jobs.

nodes.title: Monitoring
nodes.markdown:
# Monitoring

Part of: [Operations](operations.md)

Monitoring watches error rates and slow requests, and alerts whoever is on call.
nodes.summary: Monitoring watches error rates and slow requests, and alerts whoever is on call.

nodes.title: Recipe editor
nodes.markdown:
# Recipe editor

Part of: [Web app](web-app.md)

The recipe editor is where a cook writes steps and adds photos. Photos go to [file storage](file-storage.md); the text is saved through the [recipes API](recipes-api.md).
nodes.summary: The recipe editor is where a cook writes steps and adds photos.

nodes.title: Recipes API
nodes.markdown:
# Recipes API

Part of: [API](api.md)

The recipes API saves, lists and searches recipes. New recipes are added to the [search index](search-index.md) by a [background job](background-jobs.md).
nodes.summary: The recipes API saves, lists and searches recipes.

nodes.title: Search index
nodes.markdown:
# Search index

Part of: [Data](data.md)

The search index makes [search](search.md) fast. It is rebuilt from the [database](database.md) each night.
nodes.summary: The search index makes search fast.

nodes.title: Search
nodes.markdown:
# Search

Part of: [Web app](web-app.md)

Search finds recipes by name or ingredient. It asks the [recipes API](recipes-api.md), which reads the [search index](search-index.md).
nodes.summary: Search finds recipes by name or ingredient.

nodes.title: Sign-in
nodes.markdown:
# Sign-in

Part of: [Web app](web-app.md)

Sign-in lets a cook in with an email link, checked by [auth](auth-api.md). How it breaks: an expired link shows a friendly "try again" page.
nodes.summary: Sign-in lets a cook in with an email link, checked by auth.

nodes.title: Web app
nodes.markdown:
# Web app

The web app is what cooks use: they [sign in](sign-in.md), browse the [feed](feed.md), [search](search.md) and write recipes in the [recipe editor](recipe-editor.md). It gets everything from the [API](api.md).
nodes.summary: The web app is what cooks use: they sign in, browse the feed, search and write recipes in the recipe editor.
